sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
• Assist in establishing facility metrics that align with the Senior Leadership and Global Company objectives
**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor of Science degree preferred. Educational requirements may be waived in lieu of a minimum of 3 years of QA/QC experience, with at least 1 year in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively in a unionized manufacturing environment, including collaboration with union employees, supervisors, and plant leadership on quality, training, corrective action, and process compliance matters.
